changelog:
Initial release of path-alerts (v1.0.0):

- Provides real-time NJ PATH train service alerts, delays, and live arrival times.
- Monitors official Port Authority alerts feed and GTFS-Realtime data.
- Supports detailed queries by line and station for all PATH routes.
- Simple installation; no API keys required.
- Documentation includes usage examples and API integration details.
summary: Get real-time NJ PATH train service alerts, delays, status updates, and live arrival times. Monitors official Port Authority alerts feed and GTFS-Realtime data.
